observation_policy: Full annual ISD archive preserved separately per exact lat/lon/elevation. T QC1/5 only; unknown positions quarantined; conflicting same-site/same-UTC values unavailable. No merging, rounding, interpolation or gap filling.
season: March-May; night16UTC through05UTC next day; exact hourly observations; retain partial nights for slot scores, require14/14 for sampled-night minimum and crossing diagnostics
forecast: Original GFS06UTC, leads10-23, one issue, at each physical position;15UTC scenario issue; archive LastModified+10min proxy, first publication not proven
selection: Vityazevo only. Candidate must reduce all-slot MAE by at least5% in each validation year, not worsen cold-slot MAE or complete14-slot night-minimum MAE, and not add missed or false-cold complete14-slot nights in either year. At least one cold slot and complete cold night required in each year. Rank eligible by equal-year all-slot MAE; ties registry order. Otherwise GFS.
training: Each season uses only previous Vityazevo years; all training labels2022-2023. Final artifact retains the2024-fold fit2022-2023; no refit on2024 and no operational deployment.
spatial_policy: Anapa labels never enter fit/selection. Evaluate after immutable selection. Sparse already inspected archive is not a new blind test.
protected: Original detector/threshold/mask/timing, point model, interval and prior Krymsk selection remain immutable. Temperature crossings are diagnostics only; original detector not transferred.
control_years: No2025-2026 download, training, calibration, selection or evaluation
